summary.text: Jamie Callender is an Ohio House member for District 57, which includes much of eastern Lake County as well as Kirtland, Kirtland Hills, and Waite Hill. He chairs the Joint Committee on Agency Rule Review, a committee he has chaired since returning to the legislature in 2019.

paragraphs.text: Callender grew up in Concord Township and graduated from Mentor High School, then received his undergraduate degree from Cleveland State University and his law degree from Cleveland-Marshall College of Law.
He continues to practice law in Lake County and formerly served as a professor at Kent State University.
Callender is serving his eighth term in the Ohio House, having previously served there between 1997 and 2004.
He also serves on the House Finance and Judiciary committees and represents Ohio on the Great Lakes Commission.
